title: fix(app-shell): the app report index lists the reports its navigation ships, module contributions included
body:
Fixes #13273
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The app's report index (`/apps/APP/reports`) listed only the reports whose `_packageId` is the app's own. A module that contributes report entries to the app through `navigationContributions` owns its reports, and the served navigation merges those entries into the app's groups with no package stamp, so the module's reports were missing. On HotCRM the admin saw 7 of 10 reports and the service agent saw 2 of 5.

`appShippedReports` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/appReportIndex.ts`) now lists the union of:

- the reports the app's package owns (for an app with no package, the reports no package owns), as before; and
- every report that a `type: 'report'` entry of the app's served navigation names, at any depth.

Each report name is listed once. The owned document wins, and otherwise the first served document is used. A navigation entry that names a report the report list does not hold is left out, because it could not be opened. The dataset read gate (`mayOpenReport`) is unchanged and applies to the whole union.

The navigation walk is the ⌘K palette's `flattenNavigation`, moved from `CommandPalette.tsx` into `appReportIndex.ts` and imported back by the palette. The palette and the index now read the navigation through one walk instead of two. `appReportIndex.ts` is an internal module that the package entry does not re-export, so the package gains no new export. The docblock now says what the index lists.

The palette's behaviour does not change: it already showed nav-named reports through their own entries and drops them from `useAppReportEntries`'s list by name.

## Tests

New: `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.navContributions-13273.test.tsx`. It renders the real `MetadataProvider`, `MePermissionsProvider`, `ExpressionProvider` and `I18nProvider`.

- (a) The app's package ships A and B, and a module contributes C through a nested navigation group. The index lists A, B and C.
- (b) The read gate still hides a contributed report on an object the member may not read.
- (c) A navigation report entry the report list does not hold is not listed. The listing equals the gated union exactly, so a module report that no navigation entry names is not listed either.
- (d) CONTROL: a single-package app lists exactly its own reports.

**Ablation** (measured on `7fee29f8d5`): I deleted the line `take((report) => named.has(report.name as string));` with `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `4afe46b9ad24` to `4a841cc83333`. Result: `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`. (a), (b) and (c) went red and the control (d) stayed green. The restore was proven by blob hash: after restore the file is `4afe46b9ad24`, which equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Runs on `7fee29f8d5` (vitest `--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock):

- The new test plus `AppReportIndex-13020.test.tsx`: `Tests 12 passed (12)`.
- The palette family (`CommandPalette.*.test.tsx`, 7 files), both index tests and `appRouteChunks-12980.test.ts`: `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 58 passed (58)`.
- The tests that read these sources (`unsavedEditsLeave.census-13253`, `openPathObjectReaders-12811`, `navEntryDataSource-13029`, `HomeLayout.searchOpensPalette-12601`, `adr0054-ratchet`): `Tests 38 passed (38)`.
- The closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file.
- The pre-tsc battery (15 `check:*` gates plus `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`) and `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`: all exit 0.
- Lint, narrowed to the 3 changed files: `eslint --no-inline-config`, 0 errors and 12 warnings, all pre-existing. The 3 `no-explicit-any` warnings on the walk moved here from `CommandPalette.tsx` with it.
  - All 3 files are in the eslint config (`--print-config` resolves each one), and the JSON output counts 3 files.
  - Type-aware linting is not enabled (`eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the lint verdict of any file it does not touch.

Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/` test directory. I did not run whole-directory runs locally.

## Acceptance notes

- The index does not apply navigation `visible` expressions to the navigation union, just as it never applied them to owned reports. The palette applies them only to its own nav entries.
- `SearchResultsPage.tsx` keeps its own private copy of `flattenNavigation`. It is outside this card's file surface, and I left it untouched.
